english: Let $A(1,-1,-2)$, $B(3,1,-4)$, $C(-2,4,-1)$ and $D(0,-3,-1)$ be the vertices of a tetrahedron. Let $M$ be the mid-point of the edge $AB$, let $N$ be the point on the edge $AC$ such that $AN:NC=1:2$, and let $G$ be the centroid of the triangle $BCD$. The plane through $M$, $N$ and $D$ meets the line $AG$ at the point $X(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)$. Then the value of $\alpha+\beta+\gamma$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $A(1,-1,-2)$, $B(3,1,-4)$, $C(-2,4,-1)$ तथा $D(0,-3,-1)$ एक चतुष्फलक के शीर्ष हैं। माना कि $M$ कोर $AB$ का मध्य-बिन्दु है, $N$ कोर $AC$ पर वह बिन्दु है जिसके लिए $AN:NC=1:2$ है, तथा $G$ त्रिभुज $BCD$ का केन्द्रक है। बिन्दुओं $M$, $N$ तथा $D$ से होकर जाने वाला तल रेखा $AG$ से बिन्दु $X(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)$ पर मिलता है। तब $\alpha+\beta+\gamma$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: Normal of the plane $MND$: $\overrightarrow{MN}=\left(-2,\dfrac23,\dfrac43\right)$, $\overrightarrow{MD}=(-2,-3,2)$, and $\overrightarrow{MN}\times\overrightarrow{MD}=\left(\dfrac23\cdot2-\dfrac43(-3),\ \dfrac43(-2)-(-2)(2),\ (-2)(-3)-\dfrac23(-2)\right)=\left(\dfrac{16}{3},\dfrac43,\dfrac{22}{3}\right)$, parallel to $(8,2,11)$.
Substituting in the plane: $8-\dfrac{16t}{3}-2+\dfrac{10t}{3}-22+17=1-2t=0$, so $t=\dfrac12$ (the plane meets $AG$ at its mid-point).
originality_note: New: a cutting plane of a tetrahedron through a mid-point, a trisection point and a vertex meets the median AG of the tetrahedron; coordinates of three section points, a plane through them and its intersection with the median (way 5). Closest known: ratio in which a plane divides a segment joining two given points. Different because: both the plane and the line are built from section points of the tetrahedron, and the intersection lands at the mid-point of AG, which a vector argument also shows.
blueprint_concepts: Coordinates in space; distance and section formulae

concept_use.Coordinates in space; distance and secti: Mid-point, internal-division (1:2) and centroid formulae give M, N, G; the final coordinates of X come from the line AG at t = 1/2.
concept_use.Plane: Normal by the cross product of MN and MD, equation of the plane through three points, and its intersection with the line AG.

stem_review: Read as a student: every point, line, vector and plane is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/numpy, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Specified which point divides AC (AN:NC = 1:2, measured from A) and which line (AG, A to the centroid of BCD); the plane meets AG at one point since the equation in t has a non-zero coefficient. Changed: No change.
key_step: Building the plane through three section points (cross product with fractional coordinates) and intersecting it with the median AG.
justification: Two ideas linked (section points of a tetrahedron, then plane through three points and line-plane intersection) with fractional arithmetic and no options. Matches the plane-construction demand of 2026-P1-Q6 (L3).
